snippet.title: The Sakabashira Game
snippet.description:
Subscribe to see more: https://www.youtube.com/riggy2k3?sub_confirmation=1
Play my game, DELUGE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810410/DELUGE/
Also live on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/riggy2k3

An amnesiac, a nurse, a baker, a fashion model, a computer genius, a tough guy and a grumpy old man wake up in a mysterious place with no exit. They have supplies, a bathroom, a kitchen and a bedroom. But there is no way out and time appears to have stopped...What is this place? Are they trapped forever? Or are they part of something beyond their understanding? Help these people and uncover the truth of...THE SAKABASHIRA GAME.

Download the game here: https://axelvejardossow.itch.io/the-sakabashira-game
